catalogue.selection: First up to 2000 catalogue ordinals with UTC mean time [60000,60010); synthetic controls appended without fitting-based selection
catalogue.synthetic_warning: Independent two-body DOP853 controls with 0.1 arcsec noise; geocentric station500; no flux, detectability, planets or observational correlation model

scope: Full bounded short-arc search, same 256-seed cap and broad Gauss/range starts; CPU20-thread batches versus GPU+CPU checked batches. Synthetic controls are not survey completeness.

cpu.scope: CPU nominal prediction screen across all modes and fixed reserved windows; no unknown-object archival census, uncertainty propagation or planetary refitting. Not included in short-arc search speedup.

gpu.scope: CPU nominal prediction screen across all modes and fixed reserved windows; no unknown-object archival census, uncertainty propagation or planetary refitting. Not included in short-arc search speedup.
